summary: Frontend-only, read-only test of the CMS Images tab regrouping (page then section collapsible accordions, separate Pillars banner section, search box) and the public /pillars page. All requested checks passed at 1920x800, plus a quick mobile check at 390. Nothing was uploaded, replaced or deleted.

issues: Asset grid stays at 2 columns (grid-cols-2), so cards are narrow: the 'Used on site' badge is cut off to 'USED', the section select is cut off and the key wraps ('pillars_page_ba / nner'). Consider grid-cols-1 below sm.

The pillars_page_banner (16:3 panorama) thumbnail uses a 4:3 object-cover box, so the card shows only the middle of the panorama. Optional: use an aspect-[16/3] or object-contain thumbnail for that section.

passed_checks: Login as superadmin, then the Images tab: page groups image-page-brand/home/pillars/subsidiaries/about/footer render in the correct order (image-page-other is absent because no custom-upload data exists)
All 12 section toggles have aria-expanded=false and there are 0 asset-card-* on open
image-section-toggle expands and collapses (pillars_page: 3 cards, then 0 after collapsing)
Pillars group contains image-section-pillars_page_banner (only asset-card-pillars_page_banner) and image-section-pillars_page (pillars_page_01/02/03 only)
Clicking the banner thumbnail opens the focal editor; focal-pillar-banner-preview ratio is 5.333 (16:3); Cancel closes it
home_partners shows logo-group-vendor(7)/partner(2)/customer(4) and 13 drag handles when not searching
Searching 'banner' auto-expands only the matching sections (pillars_page_banner, about_page/about_banner) with only matching cards and 0 drag handles
A nonsense query shows images-search-empty with 0 page groups; images-search-clear resets the value and all sections collapse again (0 cards, 6 pages)
Public /pillars: pillars-banner is 1920x360 (16:3, full width) and its image loaded (Banner Header_Pillar_Page webp); pillar-photo-01/02/03 load (naturalWidth 1400) after lazy scroll
Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390); accordions are usable
action_items: Optional: make the Images asset grid 1 column on mobile (<640px) so badges and selects are not cut off
critical_code_review_comments: Search also matches the section label (sectionLabel), so searching a word in a label (e.g. 'pillar') shows every card in that section. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
Admin.jsx is far over 700 lines; consider splitting ImagesPanel, FocalEditorModal and the logo/subsidiary helpers into separate modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Images tab uses data-testid image-page-{page}, image-section-{sec}, image-section-toggle-{sec}, images-search, images-search-clear, images-search-empty, asset-card-/asset-thumb-/asset-drag-/asset-replace-{key}. Read-only; prod Supabase data. Creds are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
